title: Lore: shared definitions
description: Pieces every lore file uses. Documentation and the shape check for tools/tactics-lore/check.py, which also checks the references between files.

id.description: snake_case, unique within its kind across every loaded lore pack. Matches the rules pack's ids, so a character id can be a preset id.

flag.description: A story flag, the same namespace as an encounter trigger's setFlag and BattleResult.FlagsSet.

artKey.description: An art key as Tactics.Logic's ArtManifests defines it: '<set>.<asset>' or '<set>.<asset>.<variant>' (e.g. 'chapters.mirewood', 'characters.aldric').

mood.description: A portrait mood: the keys of portraits/manifest.json 'moods'.

unlock.description: When the TV and phones may show this. Every key present must hold. Leave unlock out for always-known lore.

chapter.description: Shown once the party has reached this chapter.

replaces.description: Set to this entry's own id to change an id an earlier pack defined (same rule as the rules packs, spec §4.9).

line.description: One spoken or shown line. The id is stable so translations and pre-rendered voice files can key on it; changing text keeps the id.

direction.description: How to deliver it, for a voice actor or an expressive TTS model (e.g. 'dry, under his breath'). Never shown.

weight.description: Relative chance among a bark event's lines. Default 1.

barkEvents.description: Moment → lines. The engine maps its battle events to these names; any it doesn't raise yet are simply unused.
